The Boolean U/D commutator gives harmonic chains with exactly the stated tridiagonal Laplacian blocks and multiplicities. The radial block is B^T B with its known kernel; weighted-path adjugate and Kirchhoff give the tree product. Independent Gram identities M0=B^TB, 2dI-M1hat=X^TX and BB^T+XX^T=2dI prove the polynomial pairing, with artificial endpoint eigenvalues precisely accounted for. The finite stdlib verifier tested 219 pairing instances and independently computed 34 whole-graph matrix-tree cofactors; the proof establishes the universal claim.

originality.rationale: The new theorem evaluates the entire Laplacian characteristic polynomial, Kirchhoff spanning-tree number and a Gram-duality pairing between radial and first harmonic sectors for all consecutive rank intervals. The primary full text gives edge and face structure, the closest published same-graph result evaluates only distances and diameter, and the older middle-cube spectral result uses an induced inclusion-only graph. Neither of these mathematical claims implies the evaluated all-interval factorization or pairing. The classical full cube and two-rank Johnson special cases are acknowledged as already known. Search coverage is not exhaustiveness; see residual risks.
residual_risks: A pre-existing equivalent theorem may use aliases such as cardinality-homogeneous set-system polytopes or rank-selected Boolean lattices; indexed searches do not exclude all older or unindexed literature.
